meta.name: gptq
meta.description: Post-training 4-bit quantization for LLMs with minimal accuracy loss. Use for deploying large models (70B, 405B) on consumer GPUs, when you need 4× memory reduction with <2% perplexity degradation, or for faster inference (3-4× speedup) vs FP16. Integrates with transformers and PEFT for QLoRA fine-tuning.

copy.tagline: 将大模型量化压缩至4位，显存占用降低4倍
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在消费级显卡上运行70B以上大模型
copy.tagline_en: Quantize LLMs to 4-bit, reducing memory by 4x
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run 70B+ LLMs on consumer GPUs

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把大型语言模型（如 70B、405B）压缩到 4 位精度，内存减少 4 倍，推理速度提升 3-4 倍，精度损失小于 2%。
howto.when: 当你想在消费级显卡（如 RTX 4090）上部署大模型，或需要 4 倍内存压缩且精度损失小于 2% 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GPTQ 量化 Llama-2-7B 模型。
say.note: Claude 会生成量化代码并指导操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you compress large language models (e.g., 70B, 405B) to 4-bit precision, reducing memory by 4x and speeding up inference by 3-4x with less than 2% accuracy loss.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to deploy large models on consumer GPUs (e.g., RTX 4090) or need 4x memory reduction with <2% accuracy loss.
